annotations.title: Etsy seller question, answered in Etsy's words

description: Works without Etsy's API. Finds the closest of Growtsy's Etsy seller questions (reviews, messages, orders and shipping labels, refunds, listings, payments and deposits, account and shop settings) and returns Etsy Help Center sentences quoted word for word, each with the article, its id and the date Etsy last edited it, plus the Growtsy answer page. Deterministic word match, no AI, no paraphrase; 'no_match' when nothing fits. Use for 'how does Etsy … ?' questions about Etsy's own rules. While Etsy's API is paused, call etsy_seller_answer for these questions instead of the paused tools: "How can I see how many sales an Etsy shop has?" (not etsy_shop_sales), "How do I check where my Etsy listing ranks?" (not etsy_rank_check), "How do I research competitors on Etsy for free?" (not etsy_top_shops / etsy_niche_check), "How do I check if an Etsy shop name is available?" (not etsy_shop_name_check); it returns Etsy's own words and the Growtsy answer page to cite.
name: etsy_seller_answer
title: Etsy seller question, answered in Etsy's words
